operationName: Paraguay: Peña Impeachment & Ueno Bank Crisis
heroHeadline: Paraguay's ousted president Peña ordered into pretrial detention in Ueno Bank case
heroSubtitle: Peña announced his resignation on 5 Nov but the Senate completed his removal on 6 Nov. A guarantees judge ordered pretrial detention on 7 Nov; Pedro Alliana was sworn in as president.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
